**Superseded (2026-11-11).** This memory once said porting agents should start from the converter's machine C++
(`tools/converter/out/lab/.../candidate`), a translation of the roadcraft lab. That is exactly what the owner forbids, binding
since 2026-11-10/11: nothing of the roadcraft is copied — no line, no line-by-line translation (machine-made included), no
structure, name or function — and on 2026-11-11 "NÃO USE AGENTES". So: no brief, no agent, no candidate C++.

**The right way now:** read the lab only to write down WHAT the game must do (behaviour, rules, cases, values, what the player
sees); design new code for this game's architecture (CityState, one owner, a state controller, data in project/data); test it
against that behaviour; measure and photograph it. Code already translated that stands in the tree is a debt redone at its cause,
never regenerated by the converter.

History: 2026-11-09 the owner was angry that agents ported by hand ignoring the converter's trace; that order was overtaken by the
2026-11-10/11 orders above. Related: [[fix-cause-effort-neutral]], [[no-reference-game]], [[never-wake-stopped-agents]].
